bagPolicy.summary: T-Mobile Arena prohibits bags or backpacks except for small personal bags measuring up to 9″ x 5″ x 2″. Fanny packs, crossbody bags, and clear stadium bags are allowed if they meet size requirements.
allowed: small personal bags (9″ x 5″ x 2″ max)
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at T-Mobile Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Use the ground level of the New York-New York parking garage for rideshare drop-off. For pickup, use the rideshare area at New York-New York or Park MGM.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at T-Mobile Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is on all levels. Buy it at axs.com, by calling 888.929.7849, or through the Box Office at boxoffice@tmobilearena.com or 702-692-1616, and say you need accessible seating when you order. For other accommodations, contact Guest Services ahead of time at guestservices@tmobilearena.com or 702-692-1515.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office is on the east side of the arena facing Toshiba Plaza. Will Call tickets can be picked up there during regular business hours and at showtime on event day, only by the account holder, with a valid government-issued ID and the card used to buy.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Main Entrance is on the northeast side facing Toshiba Plaza, across from Park MGM. The T-Mobile Fast Pass entrance is the first door on the right at the Main Entrance, and Dash Pass expedited entry is at the West Suite Entrance off Park Avenue. ADA drop-off is at the East Suite Entrance.
